svg.title: One engine, many surfaces
svg.desc: Two matching panels. In Claude Code, the terminal CLI, IDE extensions, desktop app, web app and Agent SDK all connect to one Claude Code engine; in Codex, the CLI, IDE extension, ChatGPT desktop app, Codex Cloud and SDK all connect to Codex core through the App Server. The CLI, IDE and SDK run it on your machine, the web apps in a cloud VM, and the desktop apps either.

g.text: Mobile apps and Remote Control are remote screens for a session that runs elsewhere.
